{{Top|leg}}
The '''Forbidden Gardens of Nuswatta''' was a complex of gardens located on the planet of [[Nuswatta]]. The Gardens, located in a caldera of an extinct volcano,<ref name="EA" /> were originally cultivated as a royal retreat for the court of the [[Xim's empire|Empire]] of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]]. All who entered without permission were put to [[Death/Legends|death]], and legend had it that the Gardens were cultivated by a cadre of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] blinded at birth. Traitors, failed [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] military officers, and defeated enemies were said to have been executed there.<ref name="Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> Only those in Xim's court were allowed to see them, everyone else was put to death.<ref name="EA" />

After Xim's defeat by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] at the [[Third Battle of Vontor]] in [[25,100 BBY]], the Forbidden Gardens were allowed to fall into ruin. 

In [[10,000 BBY]] They were included on a list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] by the historian [[Vicendi]]. In the last centuries of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] the ruins were opened to the public,<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] once visited the Gardens. The ruins could be the hiding place for delinquent [[Cronese]] children, however, which could complicate tours, as the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Bleys Harand]] discovered during his visit to the Gardens.<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-3-xim-the-despot|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 3 - "Xim the Despot"}}</ref>
